newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X to spin off company in dividend.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X to spin off company in dividend.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday that unit Bro-X Minerals Ltd filed to distribute up to 22 million common shares to Bre-X shareholders as a dividend-in-kind.
Bre-X said it would pay the dividend on October 24 to shareholders of record at October 23.
On October 15, Bre-X had 219.1 million common shares issued and outstanding.
Under the plan, Bre-X shareholders will receive one Bro-X common share every 10 Bre-X shares.
The company said no fractional Bro-X shares would be issued. Instead, shareholders would receive a cash payment.
Bresea Resources Ltd, which currently holds a 22.36 percent equity interest in Bre-X, will acquire the same stake in Bro-X, under the plan, it said.

Bre-X also said Bresea has the right to convert its two million outstanding preferred shares of Bro-X into an additional two million common shares, which would result in Bresea holding 28.75 percent interest in the new company.

Bre-X said the Alberta Stock Exchange, where the new firm's shares will trade, has conditionally approved the listing, subject to it fulfilling all exchange requirements such as the distribution of shares to a minimum number of holders, Bre-X said.

It said Bro-X currently has working capital of about C$4.86 million and will acquire Bre-X's stakes in the Sable and Sangihe properties in Indonesia for C$2.86 million. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
